Installation
------------

Install with pip::

    pip install squeezer

Requirements
~~~~~~~~~~~~

* Python 3.10 or newer
* A POSIX shell

See :ref:`usage-guide` and :class:`squeezer.Engine` for details.

Usage
-----

.. code-block:: python

    from squeezer import Engine
    Engine(".").context("fix bug", 3000)
